Position Overview

As a Software Engineer, Intern, you'll have the opportunity to spend 12 weeks working on one (or more) of the engineering teams at SingleStore. You will be at the forefront of real-time technology that’s revolutionizing how companies run their businesses every day. With a continuous release cycle, our engineers are accustomed to moving quickly in a rapid production environment. To do this successfully, we work collaboratively and creatively across teams to maximize our opportunity for impact. We also believe it’s important to celebrate our wins together, whether it be at a local spot or getting out of the city for some exploring.

As a Software Engineer, Intern, you will be empowered to own your projects end-to-end and be an active contributor throughout the product life cycle. To expedite your growth path, you will partner with engineers who deeply care about your success and will lend their expertise to your professional development. Our engineers are not just technical partners/mentors, but are also business partners who are exposed to all areas of the business, working with teams such as product, marketing, and sales.

Role and Responsibilities

Our Software Engineers work on small, collaborative teams to help drive our company forward. Our interns are responsible for projects that are deployed continuously into production over the course of their internship. Your work will include everything from writing new features to testing software and you’ll gain a significant understanding of both the product and the business.

Required Skills and Experience

- Enrolled in a B.S. Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline

- Deep understanding of C.S. fundamentalsStrong programming skills with C++ or C

- Passionate about building highly reliable software

- Firm grasp of algorithms and data structures

Preferred skill and experience

Understanding of core C.S. fundamentals, in particular operating systems, distributed systems, concurrency, multithreading, and server architectures.

SingleStore delivers the cloud-native database with the speed and scale to power the world’s data-intensive applications. With a distributed SQL database that introduces simplicity to your data architecture by unifying transactions and analytics, SingleStore empowers digital leaders to deliver exceptional, real-time data experiences to their customers. SingleStore is venture-backed and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Seattle, Lisbon and Bangalore.

Consistent with our commitment to diversity & inclusion, we value individuals with the ability to work on diverse teams and with a diverse range of people.

Sponsorship is available for this position and other select roles.

- Develop and test data pipelines that ingest, transform, and curate data within Cambridge’s cloud data platform.

- Build and maintain API integrations and ETL/ELT workflows with guidance from data architects and engineers.

- Support data quality and data governance processes that improve the reliability and accessibility of enterprise data.

- Collaborate with data architects, engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable data solutions.

- Document data solutions and contribute to enterprise reporting and analytics initiatives.

- Use technologies such as SQL, Python, Snowflake, Azure, Event Hubs, Kafka, dbt, Git, Azure DevOps, Confluence, CI/CD, and database change management tools.

What We Are Looking For

- Current undergraduate or graduate student pursuing Data Engineering, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

- Experience with or coursework in Python, SQL, cloud technology, or data engineering concepts.

- Interest in developing data pipelines, APIs, ETL/ELT workflows, and cloud-based data solutions.

- Understanding of data governance and data quality principles.

- Analytical thinking, attention to detail, problem-solving ability, and a willingness to learn.

- Ability to collaborate effectively in an enterprise data environment.

Program Summary: Cambridge’s Next Step 11-week paid summer internship program (May 17 – July 30) gives students the opportunity to gain valuable insight into both their chosen field and the financial service industry while working on meaningful projects that contribute to business outcomes. Why Cambridge?

Cambridge has competitive benefits and promotes a work/life balance to encourage individual success.

- Vacation/sick time

- 401K retirement plan with company matching program

- Eleven paid holidays

Cambridge is a financial solutions firm that provides business support services to thousands of independent financial advisors. Risepoint is an education technology company that helps regional universities launch and grow online programs for modern learners. Risepoint supports more than 100 universities and colleges across five countries, with programs concentrated in high-demand fields including nursing, healthcare, teaching, business, technology, and public service. Our suite of products and services supports the full student journey and each university’s long-term goals. Together, we increase access to affordable education that delivers a strong return on investment for learners and meets employer and community needs. Learn more at risepoint.com.

About This Opportunity

As a Analytics Solutions Co-op, you will play a meaningful role in the Analytics Solutions team, partnering closely with analytics team to help shape the future of the organization through data-driven insights and strategic thinking.

In this role, you’ll collaborate across functions and gain exposure to a wide range of stakeholders—including senior leaders—while contributing to projects that influence key business decisions.

Co-op Duration
This opportunity runs from January 2027 through June 2027, with some flexibility on start and end to accommodate academic schedules.

Weekly Schedule
This is a full-time co-op experience, 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, designed to provide hands-on, real-world exposure.

The Impact You Will Make

As an Analytics Solutions Co-op, you’ll work on high-impact, fast-paced projects that support meaningful business outcomes while accelerating your professional growth. You’ll gain exposure to core analytics disciplines — including data analysis, SQL and data preparation, business intelligence and dashboard development, and analytics product design — applied broadly across marketing, performance, and enrollment domains.

With mentorship from senior leaders, you’ll help conduct analyses that inform Risepoint’s strategic direction. Working cross-functionally, you’ll structure analyses, develop hypotheses, and deliver actionable, value-added recommendations that drive business growth.

How You Will Bring Our Mission to Life

What You Will Do

- Support end-to-end analytics projects across the Analytics Solutions team: pulling and cleaning data, extracting key insights, communicating hypotheses to stakeholders, and helping inform business decisions

- Write and optimize SQL queries in Databricks to prepare, transform, and validate datasets for analysis and reporting

- Help build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reporting experiences (semantic models, DAX measures) that deliver insights to internal leadership and university partners

- Contribute to Risepoint’s AI-first analytical practices by incorporating tools like Claude and Databricks Genie into day-to-day workflows to accelerate analysis and communication; AI is a productivity tool here, not a replacement for analytical judgment, and the expectation is full ownership of and accountability for the work product

- Conduct exploratory analyses (funnel, cohort, and performance) to surface KPIs, answer business questions, and connect marketing investment to downstream outcomes through enrollment

- Form a deep understanding of Risepoint’s data, systems/tools, processes, personnel, and strategic direction across the analytics ecosystem

- Collaborate cross-functionally with senior Directors and VPs to communicate data insights and support data-informed decisions

- You will work closely with a Director, Manager, and Analysts

What Success Looks Like

- Good communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex concepts and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels

- Strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously

- Good ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and maintain analytical accuracy under time pressure; you validate before you publish and catch discrepancies before they reach stakeholders

- Collaborative problem-solving mindset and the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams, driving change through analytical insights
- Impact is measured by the quality and reliability of the analyses, dashboards, and insights you help deliver, and how directly they inform Analytics Solutions’ work and business decisions

- You will also grow in your ability to independently manage and execute data analytics projects end to end

What You’ll Bring to the Team

Experience That Matters Most

Applicants must be active, enrolled students in Spring 2027 to apply for this position.

- Strong proficiency and/or working experience in SQL, Databricks, Excel modeling, Power BI, and data analysis

- Demonstrated ability to conceive and execute quantitative analysis and deliver data-driven insights

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Experience That’s Great to Have

- Prior working experience using SQL, Databricks, Excel modeling, Power BI, and data analysis to clean data, extract insights, and communicate takeaways to leadership

- Prior internship / co-op experience preferred

- Agile workstyle to meet evolving business needs in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment
- undefined

San Jose

Responsibilities

About the Team:
The Global Traffic Architecture (GTA) team at ByteDance designs, builds, and operates large-scale, multi-cloud network services that accelerate and optimize traffic for TikTok and a broad portfolio of ByteDance internal applications. Our platform delivers core capabilities including L4/L7 load balancing, L4/L7 traffic acceleration, global ingress, and forward proxy. Joining GTA means partnering with a world-class team to build TikTok-scale network infrastructure that serves billions of users worldwide.

To further support ByteDance's continued global growth, the GTA team is looking for interns to contribute to our multi-cloud, cloud-native traffic architecture.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.
Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.
Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.

Responsibilities:
- Design and develop core traffic software (L4/L7 load balancers, caching) on our traffic platform to process terabyte-scale data in real time.
- Build data pipelines and telemetry systems that enable data-driven traffic control.
- Develop API acceleration and other networking services on top of our multi-cloud traffic platform.
- Troubleshoot production issues and drive performance tuning for online traffic.
- Research emerging technologies to make traffic processing more efficient and scalable.
- Build platform capabilities—control plane, self-service APIs, developer tooling, and supporting infrastructure—that power the Global Traffic Architecture.
- Develop AI-powered engineering productivity tools and agents (LLM-based assistants, workflow automation, and operations copilots) to accelerate development, diagnosis, and operations across the traffic platform.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:
- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline.
- Proficiency in developing systems in one or more of Python, Go, Rust, C, or C++, with strong hands-on experience in Linux environments.
- Solid understanding of core network protocols, including TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, and DNS.
- Familiarity with AI/LLM application development, including areas such as prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or the design of AI-assisted developer tools.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in AI Agent development, such as building LLM-powered agents, tool use, multi-agent systems, or agent frameworks.
- Experience developing proxy software such as Nginx or Envoy.
- Experience with modern network protocols such as HTTP/2, HTTP/3 (QUIC), and TLS 1.3.

Founded in 2012, ByteDance's mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. With a suite of more than a dozen products, including TikTok, Lemon8, CapCut and Pico as well as platforms specific to the China market, including Toutiao, Douyin, and Xigua, ByteDance has made it easier and more fun for people to connect with, consume, and create content.​

Software Engineer Intern (Summer 2027)

> ENFOS, Inc. · Durham, United States · Full-time · Posted 2026-09-04

Workplace: on_site

Department: Engineer

Description

ENFOS is redefining how global enterprises manage long-term environmental risk. As the category leader in Environmental Obligation Management, our platform centralizes and automates the full lifecycle of Environmental Remediation Obligations (EROs) and Asset Retirement Obligations (AROs)—replacing fragmented spreadsheets and outdated tools with a purpose-built, multi-tenant SaaS platform.

For 25 years, ENFOS has helped the world’s leading industrial companies stay audit-ready, SOX-compliant, and financially in control of their environmental obligations. Privately held and profitable, ENFOS operates with no direct competitors and supports a blue-chip customer base spanning energy and natural resources, chemicals, manufacturing, and logistics end markets.

With regulatory pressure rising and ESG scrutiny intensifying, ENFOS is uniquely positioned to empower Finance, Legal, and Remediation teams to improve decision-making, mitigate risk, and drive long-term balance sheet reliability.

About the Role

As a Software Engineering Intern at ENFOS, you will work alongside experienced engineers building and modernizing an enterprise SaaS platform used to manage complex environmental and financial obligations.

This is a hands-on engineering internship. You will contribute to real product development and may work across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, data processing, document management, AI-enabled capabilities, or platform infrastructure depending on your technical strengths and current product initiatives.

You will participate in the same engineering practices used by our development teams, including design discussions, implementation, code reviews, testing, and iterative delivery, and gain experience building reliable, secure, and scalable enterprise software.

We are looking for interns who have strong computer science fundamentals, enjoy solving difficult problems, and are comfortable learning beyond a single technology stack.

How We Work:                                          

-   Agile development: Work in two-week sprints with clear goals, ownership, collaboration, and rapid iteration.

-   Engineering quality: Build production-quality software with an emphasis on clean architecture, automated testing, code reviews, security, performance, and long-term maintainability.
-   Modern technology stack: Gain hands-on experience across our technology stack, including Java, Spring Boot, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, WebSockets, GitLab, Docker, Ansible, and CI/CD, as well as modern AI-assisted development tools.
-   End-to-end engineering: Depending on the project, work across frontend, backend, APIs, data, AI-enabled capabilities, and platform services rather than being limited to a single area of the technology stack.
-   Engineer ownership: Take initiative, solve real problems, and contribute ideas that improve the performance, scalability, reliability, and user experience of the ENFOS platform.
-   Mentorship and growth: Work closely with experienced engineers, participate in technical design and code reviews, and develop the skills needed to build and understand enterprise-scale software systems.

Responsibilities

As a Software Engineering Intern at ENFOS, you will work alongside experienced engineers to design, build, test, and improve production software used by global enterprises to manage complex environmental and financial obligations. Depending on your skills, interests, and project needs, you may contribute across frontend, backend, data, AI-enabled features, or platform engineering.

You will have opportunities to:

-   Build production software: Design, develop, test, and enhance features across the ENFOS platform using modern software engineering practices.
-   Develop user-facing experiences: Build responsive, intuitive interfaces and reusable components using technologies such as React and TypeScript.
-   Build backend services and APIs: Develop application services, business logic, integrations, and REST APIs using technologies such as Java and Spring Boot.
-   Work with data and documents: Build capabilities for processing, validating, transforming, and presenting complex environmental, financial, and transactional data.
-   Contribute to AI-enabled capabilities: Work on projects involving document intelligence, natural-language interfaces, automation, forecasting, or other AI-assisted workflows where applicable.
-   Solve real engineering problems: Investigate requirements, evaluate technical approaches, troubleshoot issues, and implement maintainable solutions.
-   Integrate across the application stack: Connect frontend applications with backend services, APIs, databases, and other platform capabilities.
-   Improve performance and scalability: Identify opportunities to improve application responsiveness, reliability, maintainability, and scalability.
-   Write high-quality code: Follow engineering standards for architecture, testing, code reviews, security, documentation, and maintainability.
-   Collaborate across teams: Work with engineering, product, design, and implementation teams to translate business requirements into working software.
-   Use modern development tools: Gain hands-on experience with GitLab, CI/CD, Docker, automated testing, AI-assisted development tools, and enterprise development workflows.
-   Contribute to real enterprise systems: Work on production-quality software while receiving mentorship and technical guidance from experienced engineers.

Requirements

We are looking for students with strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn new technologies quickly. You do not need experience with every technology listed below.

-   Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
-   Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and core computer science concepts
-   Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, such as Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript
-   Experience building software through coursework, personal projects, internships, research, or other hands-on development
-   Understanding of fundamental software engineering concepts including modular design, debugging, testing, and maintainable code
-   Familiarity with Git and version-control workflows
-   Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to break complex problems into manageable technical solutions
-   Ability and willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies, frameworks, and areas of the application stack
-   Strong attention to code quality, structure, readability, and maintainability
-   Ability to communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with engineers and cross-functional teams
-   Interest in using AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of the software development process

Experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus, but not required:

-   Frontend: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, responsive UI development
-   Backend: Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, distributed application development
-   Data and AI: Python, machine learning, LLMs, document processing, embeddings, data engineering
-   Databases: SQL, PostgreSQL, relational data modeling
-   Platform and DevOps: Docker, Linux, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, messaging or distributed systems
-   Software quality: Automated testing, performance optimization, secure coding, or accessibility

Benefits

-   Competitive internship compensation aligned with market rates
-   Flexible, rolling start and end dates set individually to fit your academic calendar
-   Potential to continue part-time during the school year for strong performers, subject to business need and work authorization
-   Opportunity to gain hands-on experience working with a high-performing engineering team
-   Exposure to real-world projects supporting enterprise-scale systems
-   Professional mentorship, learning, and career development throughout the internship

Apply

[Apply at ENFOS, Inc.](https://apply.workable.com/enfos-inc/j/CA15908E0A/apply)

About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

As a Software Engineer Intern, you will be shown how to build Zip’s core products and architecture. You will ship features that will be immediately used by our users and will work with a tight-knit team that values open communication and cross-functional collaboration. We move quickly to solve a wide range of complex technical and product challenges. While we are an experienced team that can provide constant guidance and mentorship, we value engineers who can scope and solve difficult technical challenges.

Previous interns have worked on:

- Internal AI bot: a bot that uses generative AI to aggregate info from various sources (e.g. google doc, notion, Slack, Zip help site) and generate answers - it’s now actively used by both engineering and customer teams at Zip

- Devbox: building a prototype that bootstraps the development environment in AWS cloud for all zip engineers - this project is now being used by 80+ engineers

- Virtual Card Auto Lock: a feature that automatically locks virtual cards based on various policies, such as after a certain expiration date, when reported lost, or in the event of an overdraft. This feature, along with a self-serve onboarding tool, is now live in our virtual card product

You Will

- Design and build highly reliable and resilient products and features

- Work closely with cross-functional product and customer-facing teams to understand requirements and ship thoughtful solutions

- Write high-quality, extensible, and maintainable code

- Design and build scalable frontend applications and components

- Design and build APIs to drive existing and new features for a web-based application

Qualifications

- Pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science or a related technical field involving coding (e.g. physics or math), with an expected graduation date between December 2027 - June 2028

- Experience with web applications and API development. At Zip, our stack includes Python, Javascript/TypeScript, React, and GraphQL

- Ability and interest to quickly learn new frameworks, architecture patterns, and programming languages as needed

- Fantastic written and verbal communication skills

- Prior internship in a high-growth startup environment

Our internships are full-time and hybrid, based in our San Francisco HQ office. Our Summer 2027 internship runs either May–August or June–September.

The estimated hourly pay range for this role is $56 - 60 per hour.

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work

- 🍽️ Catered breakfasts, lunches & dinners

- 🚠 Team building events & happy hours

- 💻 Apple equipment

- 🏠 Intern Housing stipend

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

Launch your career where innovation meets immediate impact. As an intern at Verizon, you won't just join a specific business unit - you’ll gain broad exposure across our entire AI-first ecosystem. We value cross-disciplinary thinkers and offer rising seniors a true launchpad: every internship paves the way to join our full-time, elite two-year rotational program, unlocking cross-organizational mobility and rapid skill development.

We’re seeking future-focused builders who combine technical AI fluency with an innate drive to grow. Ideal candidates are agile problem solvers who think in systems, leverage data, and streamline complex processes. Crucially, we’re looking for leaders with the capacity to break down silos, influence cross-functional teams, build lasting trust, and navigate AI ethics with a customer-first lens—all while collaborating with mentors across business units to help shape the future of tech.

What you’ll be doing...

You and your team will be working on a real project in real time: it’ll be impactful and timely work that the business depends on. In recent summers, interns in Consumer AI & Marketing Strategy have:

- Assisted with the development, training, and deployment of predictive and propensity models to evaluate customer behaviors, churn risk, and lifecycle triggers.

- Supported micro segmentation and personalization efforts by helping translate model outputs into tailored customer journeys for marketing execution.

- Monitored, evaluated, and refined model performance metrics to help ensure high accuracy, relevancy, and business impact.

In this hybrid internship, based out of Basking Ridge, NJ, you’ll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager. If relocation is required, relocation assistance may be available.

You’ll also join us for the Intern Marquee event in Basking Ridge, NJ, a unique, in-person experience designed exclusively for all US interns. About us

Forus is building an AI-powered network that connects doctors, pharmacies, payers, and biopharma to accelerate new science to patients.

Our platform automates the complexity between a doctor prescribing a medicine and a patient starting treatment, including insurance coverage, financial assistance, and supply chain navigation. We provide this support free to doctors and patients, helping them get life-changing medicine faster, cheaper, and easier. The resulting network enables biopharma companies to design better research, launch new drugs more effectively, and invest in harder-to-treat conditions.

Forus has exceptional product-market fit and is growing rapidly through organic adoption:

- Accelerating scale: We already support patients across more than 85% of ZIP codes and partner with 9 of top 15 largest biopharma companies in the world.

- AI-native, durable model: Our business becomes stronger as AI improves, as every new doctor, patient, and partner makes the network more valuable.

- Backing to build for the long term: We raised $300M+ from leading investors to build an exceptional team and unlock the full scale of the opportunity.

Our number one priority is scaling to market demand. We are looking for individuals who are high horsepower, high throughput, and hyper resourceful to help us increase capacity and grow. We move fast and need to move faster.

If we succeed, science will be the only limit to medicine.

All full-time roles are in person in New York.

About the role

As a Software Engineering Intern at Forus, you will join our engineering team as an engineer, not as an observer. From your first weeks, you’ll ship production code, own meaningful technical problems, and build software that helps providers, patients, and life sciences organizations bring innovative therapies to more patients.

Unlike a traditional internship, you’ll work on the same systems as our full-time engineers and contribute to the same codebase, engineering reviews, and technical discussions. You’ll work directly with experienced engineers, the head of engineering, and the CEO on some of the company’s highest-priority technical challenges, whether that’s provider-facing products, AI systems, life sciences platforms, growth acceleration, or infrastructure. This isn’t an internship spent building internal demos or isolated side projects. You will help build the platform that sits between scientific innovation and patient treatment, working on the products and AI systems that providers and biopharma depend on every day.

We invest in exceptional interns differently than most companies. Many stay with us across multiple semesters, take on increasing ownership as they grow, and some receive return offers and start vesting equity before they graduate. We think the best engineers should start building their careers early, and we’re looking for people we hope will help define Forus for years to come.

This is a demanding role, with a high level of autonomy and responsibility. You will be expected to “act like an owner” and commit yourself to Forus’ success. If you are low-ego, hungry to learn, and excited about intense, impactful work that drives both company growth and accelerated career progression, we want to hear from you.

Please note that we hire Interns year-round.

If you join, you will

- Own meaningful technical problems from an ambiguous idea through design, implementation, and production

- Ship production code that directly impacts providers, patients, and life sciences partners.

- Help decide what to build, not just how to build it, by working closely with users and developing your own product intuition

- Build product features, AI-powered systems, life sciences products, internal tools, or engineering infrastructure, depending on where you can have the greatest impact

- Work directly with engineering, product, design, operations, and company leadership while learning how a world-class engineering organization operates and scales

- Be treated and measured like a full engineer, with the ownership, code review, and quality bar to match

We’ll be most excited if you have

- Strong computer science fundamentals and programming ability, currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a related technical field

- A track record of building things outside the classroom, whether through internships, research, startups, hackathons, open-source contributions, or side projects

- Strong product instincts. You form opinions about what is worth building and can distinguish what is valuable from what is merely possible

- The ability and willingness to work wherever the problem is, whether frontend, backend, infrastructure, AI, or something entirely new

- A track record of moving quickly, finding shortcuts, and going to unreasonable lengths to deliver on goals

- High NPS with your former teammates and classmates

This is a list of ideal qualifications for this position. If you don't meet every single one of them, you should still consider applying! We’re excited to work with people from underrepresented backgrounds, and we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

Working with us

Forus is based in New York, with our full team working out of a beautiful and spacious office in SoHo.

We run as a high-trust environment with high autonomy, which requires that everyone is fully competent and operates in line with our principles:

- Do the math. Be rigorous, assume nothing. Break problems down and reason from the ground up. Stay open to changing your mind.

- Resourceful optimism. Assume problems are solvable. Be audacious. Resist false constraints and push beyond the obvious before deciding.

- Spit it out. Speak directly, invite critique, avoid equivocation. We want right answers, not comfortable ones. All killer, no filler.

- Raise the bar. Hold a high standard for your pace and execution, and elevate the performance of the team around you. Mamba mentality.

- Fight for users. Start with users’ realities, not ours. Resist optimizing for internal convenience over user outcomes.

We provide competitive compensation with meaningful equity (for full-time employees). Everyone who joins will be a major contributor to our success, and we reflect this through ownership and pay.

We also provide rich benefits to ensure you can focus on creating impact (for full-time employees):

- Fully covered medical, vision, and dental insurance.

- Memberships for One Medical, Talkspace, Teladoc, and Kindbody.

- Unlimited paid time off (PTO) and 16 weeks of parental leave.

- 401K plan setup, FSA option, commuter benefits, and DashPass.

- Lunch at the office every day and Dinner at the office after 6:30 pm.

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our company’s size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at Forus (for full-time employees). Individual pay decisions are ultimately based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, geography, and balancing internal equity.

Forus is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

What You Get Out of the Internship​​

At Stryker, we believe that developing the next generation of talent is just as important as developing life-changing medical technologies. As an intern, you won’t just observe — you’ll contribute to meaningful projects, gain exposure to leaders who will mentor you, and experience a culture of innovation and teamwork that is shaping the future of healthcare. As an intern, you will: ​ ​

- Apply classroom knowledge and gain experience in a fast-paced and growing industry setting​
- Implement new ideas, be constantly challenged, and develop your skills​
- Network with key/high-level stakeholders and leaders of the business​
- Be a part of an innovative team and culture​
- Experience documenting complex processes and presenting them in a clear format

Who we want​​

Challengers. People who seek out the hard projects and work to find just the right solutions.​

Teammates. Partners who listen to ideas, share thoughts and work together to move the business forward.​

Charismatic networkers. Relationship-savvy people who intentionally make connections with both internal partners and external contacts.​

Strategic thinkers. Interns who propose innovative ideas and consistently exceed their performance objectives.​

Customer-oriented achievers. Individuals with an unparalleled work ethic and customer-focused attitude who bring value to their partnerships.​

Game changers. Persistent interns who will stop at nothing to live out Stryker’s mission to make healthcare better.

​

As a Data Analyst, you will work closely with our sales team, sales leadership, and customers to identify, organize, and analyze hospital data and performance metrics. These insights help demonstrate the clinical and financial impact of our solutions and interventions across healthcare organizations.

In this role, you will execute reporting and analytical activities while developing a strong understanding of the business unit, department processes, and customer needs.

Responsibilities include building reports and dashboards, preparing and validating datasets, conducting quality reviews, supporting customer analyses, and responding to routine data requests. The ideal candidate is curious, detail-oriented, and able to translate data into meaningful insights that support business and customer objectives.

- Sales: Provide reporting, content, and tools that increase sales productivity and effectiveness while streamlining processes and metrics.
- Data Governance: Help deliver trusted, high-quality data that enables scalability, process excellence, and improved partner experiences.
- Data Intelligence – Develop dashboards and visualizations of internal datasets that support informed decision-making across business units and for customers.

​

Majors Targeted: Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Technology (IT), Information Systems (MIS), Statistics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Supply Chain Management/Logistics, Finance

- Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field; must remain enrolled in a degree-seeking program after the internship.​
